# Roman Hinglish, the way you'd type it on WhatsApp. One utterance per line.
Haan theek hai, kal milte hain.
Main thodi der mein call karta hoon.
Bhai kahan pahunche?
Kal meeting hai na, agenda bhej dena.
Mujhe aaj office se jaldi nikalna hai, doctor ka appointment hai.
Report Friday tak bhej dena please, client wait kar raha hai.
Mummy ko bol dena ki main raat ko dinner pe nahi aaunga.
Ye wala design zyada accha lag raha hai, isko final kar dete hain.
Ghar ke liye doodh, bread, ande aur sabzi le aana.
Pehle code review karo, phir tests chalao, aur uske baad deploy karna.
Kal shaam ko chalte hain, nahi wait, parson chalte hain.
Server phir se down ho gaya hai, koi check kar sakta hai kya?
Maine payment kar diya hai, screenshot WhatsApp pe bhej diya.
Team, is week ka standup Wednesday ko shift ho gaya hai.
Aaj traffic bahut zyada hai, main pandrah minute late ho jaunga.
Bro wo movie dekhi kya, mujhe toh second half bilkul pasand nahi aaya.
Presentation mein pricing wala slide update karna hai, purane numbers galat hain.
Agar budget approve ho gaya toh hum next month se naya project start kar sakte hain.
Mujhe laga tha ki bug fix ho gaya hai lekin production mein abhi bhi wahi error aa raha hai.
Sab log Saturday ko party ke liye free ho na, location main group mein share kar dunga.
